scenarios.description: Exercises managed launch, explicit capture, server/client VMs, network faults, diagnostics, profiles, memory, visual evidence, and teardown.

local workspace = game:GetService('Workspace'); local parent = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonManifestScriptParent'); assert(parent and parent:IsA('Part'), 'capture parent missing'); local script = parent:FindFirstChild('CarbonManifestScript'); assert(script and script:IsA('ModuleScript'), 'capture script missing'); local disposable = parent:FindFirstChild('CarbonManifestDeletedOnMutation'); assert(disposable, 'capture deletion probe missing'); disposable:Destroy(); parent.Size = Vector3.new(7, 3, 5); parent.CFrame = CFrame.new(11, 22, 33) * CFrame.Angles(0.1, 0.2, 0.3); parent:SetAttribute('CarbonManifestRevision', 2); game:GetService('CollectionService'):AddTag(parent, 'CarbonCaptureChanged'); game:GetService('Lighting').Brightness += 0.25; script.Name = 'CarbonManifestScriptV2'; script.Source = "return 'carbon-manifest-script-v2'\n"; script:SetAttribute('CarbonManifestProbe', 'changed'); local target = Instance.new('Folder'); target.Name = 'CarbonManifestReferenceTarget'; target:SetAttribute('CarbonTargetRevision', 2); target.Parent = parent; script.Parent = target; local reference = Instance.new('ObjectValue'); reference.Name = 'CarbonManifestReference'; reference.Value = target; reference.Parent = parent; return true

' did not generate ' .. name); return output end; local function create(name, outputName, assignGenerator) local model = Instance.new('ProceduralModel'); model.Name = name; model.Parent = workspace; model.Size = Vector3.new(8, 4, 6); if assignGenerator then model.Generator = generator end; assert(model:WaitForGenerationAsync(), name .. ' parameter generation failed: ' .. model.GenerationError); if assignGenerator then model:SetAttribute('OutputName', outputName); assert(model:WaitForGenerationAsync(), name .. ' attribute generation failed: ' .. model.GenerationError); assert(model.Generator == generator, name .. ' lost the mapped generator'); generated(model, outputName) else assert(model.Generator == nil, name .. ' unexpectedly acquired a generator') end; return model end; local first = create('CarbonProceduralMappedFirst', 'MappedFirstOutput', true); local second = create('CarbonProceduralMappedSecond', 'MappedSecondOutput', true); local nilGenerator = create('CarbonProceduralNilGenerator', 'NeverGenerated', false); assert(first.Generator == second.Generator and first.Generator == generator, 'shared mapped generator references diverged'); assert(nilGenerator:FindFirstChild('NeverGenerated', true) == nil, 'nil generator produced output'); return {generator = generator:GetFullName(), first = first:GetFullName(), second = second:GetFullName()}

arguments.code: local workspace = game:GetService('Workspace'); local generator = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('Shared'):WaitForChild('ProceduralGenerator'); local first = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonProceduralMappedFirst'); local second = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonProceduralMappedSecond'); local nilGenerator = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonProceduralNilGenerator'); assert(generator:IsA('ModuleScript') and generator:GetAttribute('CarbonQualificationMetadata') == 'preserved', 'mapped generator metadata changed after capture'); assert(first and first:IsA('ProceduralModel') and first.Generator == generator, 'first procedural reference did not survive capture'); assert(second and second:IsA('ProceduralModel') and second.Generator == generator, 'second procedural reference did not survive capture'); assert(nilGenerator and nilGenerator:IsA('ProceduralModel') and nilGenerator.Generator == nil, 'nil generator edge case changed after capture'); first:ForceGeneration(); second:ForceGeneration(); assert(first:WaitForGenerationAsync(), 'first regeneration failed: ' .. first.GenerationError); assert(second:WaitForGenerationAsync(), 'second regeneration failed: ' .. second.GenerationError); assert(first:FindFirstChild('MappedFirstOutput', true), 'first regenerated output is missing'); assert(second:FindFirstChild('MappedSecondOutput', true), 'second regenerated output is missing'); return true

arguments.code: local workspace = game:GetService('Workspace'); local generator = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('Shared'):WaitForChild('ProceduralGenerator'); local first = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonProceduralMappedFirst'); local second = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonProceduralMappedSecond'); local nilGenerator = workspace:FindFirstChild('CarbonProceduralNilGenerator'); assert(first and second and nilGenerator, 'procedural edge-case models are missing'); local preserved = first:FindFirstChild('MappedFirstOutput', true); assert(preserved, 'first generated contents are missing before clearing'); first.Generator = nil; assert(first.Generator == nil, 'first generator did not clear'); assert(preserved.Parent ~= nil and first:FindFirstChild('MappedFirstOutput', true), 'clearing Generator did not preserve generated contents'); assert(second.Generator == generator, 'clearing first generator changed the shared second reference'); assert(nilGenerator.Generator == nil, 'always-nil generator edge case changed'); return true
